svg.aria-label: Your morning meeting in the lead's tab. You say Morning. The lead opens the meeting at 09:30, and the sessions hold the messages that aren't critical until it ends. Since yesterday 14 tasks are done and 1 is late, the CSV export, now due Thursday; your OK last night already started api's release. Then three decisions, each a numbered card with what it is, the facts in numbers, the options with their cost, the pick and what happens with no answer. 1, T52: Guest checkout: let buyers pay without an account? 31% of carts stop at sign-up. A: add guest checkout, 2 days of web's work. B: keep sign-up as it is, no cost. Rec: A, it wins back the most carts. With no answer: B, nothing changes. 2, T60: A second test database: the tests wait 9 minutes a day for the shared one. A: rent one, $14 a month. B: run the slow tests at night, free, results a day late. Rec: A, the wait costs more than $14. With no answer: B. 3, T66: Retire the old v1 API: 3 clients still call it, about 40 calls a day. A: switch it off on Friday, after a notice. B: keep it until the month ends. Rec: B, it gives the 3 clients time to move. With no answer: B. You answer all three in one line: 1 A, 2 B, 3 as recommended. The lead records them on their tasks, web starts guest checkout, and the meeting closes: the held messages go out.

g.text: Meeting open at 09:30. Sessions hold the messages that aren't critical until it ends.
Since yesterday 14 tasks are done and 1 is late: T33, the CSV export, now due Thursday.
Your OK last night already started api's release. Three decisions; answer in your own words.
Recorded on T52, T60 and T66, and web starts guest checkout. Meeting closed: the held messages go out now.
Guest checkout: let buyers pay without an account? 31% of carts stop at sign-up.
A: add guest checkout, 2 days of web's work. B: keep sign-up as it is, no cost.
Rec: A, it wins back the most carts. With no answer: B, nothing changes.
A second test database: the tests wait 9 minutes a day for the shared one.
A: rent one, $14 a month. B: run the slow tests at night, free, results a day late.
Rec: A, the wait costs more than $14. With no answer: B.
Retire the old v1 API: 3 clients still call it, about 40 calls a day.
A: switch it off on Friday, after a notice. B: keep it until the month ends.
Rec: B, it gives the 3 clients time to move. With no answer: B.
